title: Brain activation converts candidates into measured self learning experiments
summary: Refinement to the brain activation skill: after producing several candidate next-task ideas, the agent should define judging metrics before execution. Candidate tasks should not become implementation work just because they sound plausible; they should become measured experiments with success criteria, guardrails, and comparison logic. When a candidate is worth trying, route it into the self-learning loop so attempts can implement, measure, judge, and learn from outcomes.
